Name: Rainbow Cursor
Author: jltaylor1
Description:
[b]Rainbow Cursor[/b] makes your cursor cycle through colors.  By default, the colors are the prismatic rainbow, but new color palettes can be added by other mods or content packs.

Supports in-game configuration via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], if installed (and some additional user interface features on the configuration page if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM Options[/url] is installed).

For more details, release notes, source code, and information on how to make a content pack to add your own custom color palette, see the [url=https://github.com/jltaylor-us/StardewRainbowCursor]GitHub repo[/url].
